title.en: What I Learned Building a Stealth Layer on Top of Chrome DevTools Protocol
title.zh: CDP 反检测实战：UA-CH、原型逃逸与 19 层打断源压制

description.en: Production sites detect synthetic events, probe navigator quirks, and interrupt automation with native dialogs. A field guide from months of attack-defense testing: UA-CH profile shims, prototype-escape seals, an interruption-suppression matrix, and the lines we refuse to cross.
description.zh: 生产站点会识别合成事件、探测 navigator 特征、用原生对话框打断自动化。来自数月攻防实测的野战手册：UA-CH 档案垫片、原型逃逸封堵、打断源压制矩阵，以及我们不越过的红线。
